headline: Franchise pressure now binds across one salary market, six live-state gaps are closed, and the exact application candidate is deployed across static and backend origins.

items.title: The salary cap matters
items.evidence: One versioned OVR/POT/age curve now serves generated contracts, free agency and CPU bids; opening leagues carry measured cap pressure and can reach the configured $45M ceiling.

items.title: Narrative and sentiment read live state
items.evidence: Culture/owner events consume live adapters and fan sentiment falls back to the current team season instead of a dead record shape.

items.title: Player identity and career legacy are reachable
items.evidence: Waiver projections retain name/position/OVR/POT and the missing Franchise Legends plus General Manager Reputation mounts are present.

items.title: Rendered pixels caught the hidden defect
items.evidence: 233 responsive captures and 84 retained receipts exposed a shared decorator offset replacing OVR with player name; fixed and recaptured before release.

items.title: Exact technical deployment
items.evidence: Candidate 90f0d487 passed CI, staging and Pages promotion at artifact 9bc71a36; public backend health reports database ready at the same SHA.

followUps.title: Observe real Community Stats evidence
followUps.evidence: Verify freshness, suppression, deletion and abuse ceilings only after real opt-in activity; do not manufacture a cohort.

followUps.title: Finish public-launch authority
followUps.evidence: Zoho receive/reply-as, SHA-bound founder launch approval, lifecycle reconciliation and external Obelisk relying-party proof remain independent gates.

blockers.title: Public launch gate unchanged
blockers.evidence: launchReady remains false; technical deployment authorization is not launch approval.

honestyLedger.title: Pixel evidence corrected a green harness
honestyLedger.evidence: The capture system succeeded while the visible OVR column was wrong. The defect was fixed instead of treating file output as visual proof.

honestyLedger.title: Backend workflow red was separated from live state
honestyLedger.evidence: The exact container was healthy and publicly served before an unnecessary unchanged Caddy reload failed. Live truth and workflow truth were both reported; the idempotency defect was fixed.

honestyLedger.title: Repository-scoped security truth
honestyLedger.evidence: A broad Studio scanner resolved its own repo and produced low-confidence hash/database matches; it was not misreported as Franchise Architect evidence. The project-scoped strict scan and supply-chain scan are clean.
